text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Nice Nature seemed
like she wanted to say something, so when I asked her—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... truth is,
I was just thinking about heading back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing urgent, but...
Um... would it be alright if I did some self-training?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since her mother was coming to watch her run,
Nice Nature was likely fired up to show her best.
choice_data_list: Plus, I want to show my mom my best side!
I want to show my mom my best side, after all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's really nothing like that.
Just a whim, really. A simple whim."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even someone like me
feels like running every once in a while, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Calling out to her as she tried to head to the academy alone, I decided to join her for training.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Did you come for a run too, Nature-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
My body's been feeling a bit sluggish lately, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then hey, hey, wanna run together?
Maya's getting tired of running all alone!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A tandem run, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as long as you're fine with it, Trainer,
it's totally cool with me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Thanks, Nature-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah.
Come on, go ahead and get ready, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪
I'll be waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Did you think that was unlike me?
choice_data_list: That's not true! Let's do our best!
I think it'll be good practice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There is a lot one can learn from Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when I mentioned wanting to do what I could
before Nice Nature's mother arrived—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes, I had a feeling
you'd say that, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Were you thinking the exact same thing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I've been influenced just a little by a certain Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the two of them began running side by side—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun and Nice Nature
crossed the finish line almost simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep.
Glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she can compete on equal footing with Mayano Top Gun
and her genius-level intuition,
Nice Nature should definitely gain some confidence.
choice_data_list: With how you are now, Nature, you can go toe-to-toe with them!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on a second, Trainer.
I don't think that kind of pressure is very nice, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you really wanna get stronger,
maybe that kind of spirit is necessary, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the two of them began running side by side—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun and Nice Nature
crossed the finish line almost simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(A dead heat?
...Mayano and me...?)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's so not fair! Nature-chan,
you've been secretly training behind Maya's back, haven't you~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "No, no, I'm sure you've been running in places I don't know about too."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that makes sense too!
Totally fine with me then☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for running with me! Now I see just how amazing you are right now, Nature-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, Mayano Top Gun took off.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She's as cute and dazzling as ever, huh~.
Quite the contrast to Nature-san, wouldn't ya say?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah... thanks, thanks. Even as a background character, I'm glad I managed to give you a moment in the spotlight?
choice_data_list: Mom's gonna be thrilled with this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez.
You always have to make such a big deal out of everything!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Still, if that's really true――)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(I want to show that I'm doing well...
and put my mom's mind at ease.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the sky, Nice Nature's expression
seemed somewhat brighter and relieved.
